DiskErrors.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ "class=(checksum|io|data|deadman) |vdev_state=(DEGRADED|FAULTED|UNAVAIL|REMOVED)|SMART.*FAILED|FAILED SMART|Failed SMART|SMART Failure|(?i:I/O error|pool .*(DEGRADED|FAULTED|UNAVAIL)|Currently unreadable|Offline uncorrectable)" [86400s]))
DiskErrors.summary: Disk or ZFS errors on a Proxmox node in the last 24 hours (ZED pool events, smartd sector warnings, kernel I/O errors). Repeated once a day while they continue.

LanLegDown.expr: (sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely down` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m])) - sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely up` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m]))) or sum by (host, slave) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ `lanbond: \(slave [^)]+\): link status definitely down` | regexp `\(slave (?P<slave>[^)]+)\): link status definitely` [5m]))
LanLegDown.summary: A leg of a node's bonded lan uplink went down and did not come back. The node runs on the rest; one more port or switch failure cuts it off. See: site-manager node network show <host>.
LanLegDown.headline: lan uplink lost a leg

QuorumLost.summary: A Proxmox node lost cluster quorum. HA guests on it stop; repeated, the cluster resets itself.

HaFencing.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ "client watchdog expired|watchdog did not stop|=> 'fence'" [300s]))
HaFencing.summary: HA fencing: a node's watchdog expired or a node is being fenced (it resets).

ReplicationFailed.expr: sum by (host, replication_job) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ "replication job error|replication job .* failed" | regexp "(?P<replication_job>[0-9]+-[0-9]+)" [3600s])) > 1
ReplicationFailed.summary: A storage replication job (pvesr) failed in two runs within the hour: the HA copy of its guest (the job's first number is the VMID) on the other node is getting stale.

RootKeyChanged.summary: A key was added to or removed from root's authorized_keys on the Proxmox nodes (the line names it).

HaStuck.summary: HA is not where it should be: a node is held in maintenance mode (its HA guests stay elsewhere) or an HA service is stuck migrating. The line says which and how to clear it.

FirewallCertChanged.summary: The firewall's API certificate changed (expected after a firewall rebuild or a certificate renewal — otherwise something answers as the firewall), or expires within 30 days. The line names the old and new fingerprints.

BackupFailed.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(tappaas1|tappaas2)$"} |~ "ERROR: Backup of VM [0-9]+ failed|Backup job finished with errors|ERROR: job errors" [300s]))

OomKill.expr: sum by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(logging|tappaas-cicd)$"} |~ "^\\s*Out of memory: Killed process" [300s]))
OomKill.summary: The kernel killed a process for lack of memory.
OomKill.headline: Out of Memory Kill

HostSilent.expr: count by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(logging|tappaas-cicd)$"} [1h] offset 900s)) unless count by (host) (count_over_time({host=~"^(logging|tappaas-cicd)$"} [900s]))
HostSilent.summary: A host stopped logging 15 minutes ago: it is down, or its log forwarder is (rsyslog on a node, alloy on a VM).
